hero.tagline: I build things for the web. They break. I fix them. That's the job.

philosophy.title: Learning by breaking things
philosophy.quote: The only way to learn a new programming language is by writing programs in it.
philosophy.author: Dennis Ritchie
philosophy.personalNote: This resonates with me. I learn best by building stuff and watching it fail spectacularly. Every bug is just a puzzle waiting to be solved.
